title: ToolJet from 3.16.0 before 3.20.256 contains an improper signature verification vulnerability in StripeWebhookGuard…
description: ToolJet versions from 3.16.0 up to but not including 3.20.256 have a vulnerability in the StripeWebhookGuard component where webhook signatures are improperly verified. The system validates webhooks against a self-generated signature rather than the legitimate Stripe-Signature header. This flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to send forged Stripe events to the payment webhook endpoint, potentially enabling unauthorized activation of subscriptions, license generation, plan or seat changes, and addition of AI credits without payment.
